coverage_notes: Every supplied observation and CSV row was considered. All registered anchor pages were visually inspected, including secondary locations. This is registry-scoped identity alignment, not a full-paper census or proof of the original curator's chosen presentation. Inputs are unchanged.
shared_qualifications: C1: 0.7 V/hour *1000/3600 = 0.194444 mV/s, consistent with CRA 0.194. V(SCE)*1000 = mV(SCE) with no reference offset; graphical readings do not justify the CRA hundredth-mV digits.

PDF p.3 states 1000 ppm Cl- as NaCl, whereas CRA says 1000 ppm NaCl and provides CL- [M] = 0.0171116552617484. Salt ppm and chloride ppm are different bases; no unsupported ppm-to-molarity conversion is made. The material/N sequence, pH, scan and prehold still identify the experimental series.

Source offset pitting is the first current exceeding 0.02 mA without repassivation (PDF p.3), rather than an inferred threshold from an arbitrary curve point. The single-replicate agreement within 0.04 V is not a standard deviation. The source notes non-unique current-surge assignments; the original offset criterion remains attached.

Figures 1, 2 and (for the first five alloys) 5 are possible repeated presentations of the same material/condition series, not independently established extra runs. Alloy 1 after thermal ferritization is distinct.
